name: Aleshia Williams
biography: Aleshia Williams is a creative artist born in Montreal, Canada. Her dedication, talent, and infectious energy have allowed her to work with some of the industry’s top choreographers, on large projects and with artists such as Disney’s Zombies, Adidas, MTV, Netflix, Kesha, X-Factor UK, Lizzo, Shawn Mendes, Glowie, Sharaya J and more.
